key_findings: Ablation of spinal PROKR2 excitatory interneurons or DRG deletion of Prok2 (Nav1.8Cre) abolished pleasant touch-conditioned place preference without affecting pain or itch behaviors in mice.

Spinal PROKR2 neurons receive mainly C-fiber input from Prok2+ small DRG neurons (capsaicin/RTX-insensitive), project to Gpr83+ neurons, and respond to gentle stroking with CT-fiber-like inverted-U speed tuning.
